newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile June supermarket sales rise 5.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Chile June supermarket sales rise 5.8 percent.

text.p: Chilean supermarket sales grew 5.8 percent in June compared with the same month last year, bringing the increase in the first six months of the year to three percent, said the Association of Chilean Supermarkets (Asach).
The figures show the industry is on target to meet its goal of six percent growth in sales this year, said Asach in a statement.
"We are certain we will achieve this increase provided there are no violent changes (in the economy) which affect the retail trade," said the statement.
Supermarket sales are closely watched in Chile as barometer of overall consumer spending.
